# cloudsmith_repository_geo_ip_rules (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Organization to which the Repository belongs.
- `repository` (String) Repository to which these Geo/IP rules belong.

### Optional

- `cidr_allow` (Set of String) The list of IP Addresses for which to allow access, expressed in CIDR notation.
- `cidr_deny` (Set of String) The list of IP Addresses for which to deny access, expressed in CIDR notation.
- `country_code_allow` (Set of String) The list of countries for which to allow access, expressed in ISO 3166-1 country codes.
- `country_code_deny` (Set of String) The list of countries for which to deny access, expressed in ISO 3166-1 country codes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
